text.p: These are the leading stories in the Algerian press on Thursday as reported by the official Algerian news agency APS. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.

- President Liamine Zeroual visits Qatar, last leg of a trip which took him to Bahrain, China and Vietnam. Qatari authorities pledge to strengthen cooperation with Algeria, including in the oil and gas sector.
- The government adopts a state budget for 1997.
- Political parties are slow to react to the draft constitution issued.
- President of judges' union urges indpendence judiciary to avoid the "trap of illegitimacy".
- The number of strikes staged by unionised workers totalled 278 in 1996, mostly over pay.
